top_fixes.rule: Requests contain service fields in `data` and metadata in `call`; every response has `result`, successful responses also `data`; success requires HTTP "200" and `result.returnCode` "1".
top_fixes.why: Incorrect request envelopes or success checks can break every service-backed case or falsely report a failed transaction as successful.
top_fixes.fix: All seven business tools, request bodies and shared post_process_code: move service fields into `data` and add `call: {ani: <caller ANI>, lang: "tr"}`. Accept envelope success only when HTTP status is exactly 200 and `result.returnCode` is exactly "1", then apply the existing service-specific success checks. Preserve the cards.list no-eligible-card warning route before generic error routing.

top_fixes.rule: On successful sending, announce that the statement was sent and route to main menu; success requires the service's "DONE" state.
top_fixes.why: Successful e-mail cases currently wait for another customer turn instead of immediately recording the required main-menu exit.
top_fixes.fix: after_send code and a dedicated success end pair: replace `go('completed', ...)` with an immediate transition to `fin_send_success`. Set close_call outcome to `main_menu` and reason to `""`; route to a custom terminal speaking exactly: "Ekstreniz kayıtlı e-posta adresinize gönderildi. Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum." Retain the service's DONE-state success requirement.

top_fixes.rule: After successful change, announce the new week and dates using preview dates, then route to main menu; service success requires `exitState` "OK" and `responseCode` "0".
top_fixes.why: Successful statement-week changes likewise leave the call in completed, delaying or losing the mandatory main-menu outcome.
top_fixes.fix: after_change code and a dedicated success end pair: retain the selected week and statement.week.decide preview dates, build the prescribed card-specific change acknowledgement, and transition immediately to `fin_change_success` rather than completed. Set outcome to `main_menu` and reason to `""`; its custom terminal must speak the acknowledgement followed by "Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum." Keep the exitState OK and responseCode 0 checks.

top_fixes.rule: Follow the offer-answer table; a combined debt-and-e-mail request bypasses the offer after debt reading.
top_fixes.why: A plain refusal of the follow-up offer consumes failed attempts instead of producing the normal main-menu exit, breaking common end-of-call cases.
top_fixes.fix: handle_offer shared main() code: before the fallback tries() branch, add `elif stage == 'offer' and confirm == 'no': go('fin_menu')`. Ensure fin_menu records outcome `main_menu`, reason `""`, and end_menu speaks "Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum."

top_fixes.rule: Always use full currency names everywhere, including combined no-debt sentences: Türk Lirası, Dolar, Euro and İngiliz Sterlini; never codes, "Avro", "Sterlin" or "pound".
top_fixes.why: Every fractional Türk Lirası amount currently uses a forbidden shortened currency name, potentially failing many otherwise correct debt readings.
top_fixes.fix: Shared money() code used by handle_opening and after_balance: replace `unit=dict(CURRENCIES)[c] if not frac or c!='TL' else 'lira'` with `unit=dict(CURRENCIES)[c]`. Preserve the exact nonzero kuruş portion so fractional amounts also say "Türk Lirası".
